_note: Ashwyrm's Roost (Docs/Expansion.md §1, §8; owner r2): the raid map and its six quests. Creatures in raid_ashwyrm_roost_creatures.json, people and dialogues in raid_ashwyrm_roost_people.json, quest items, reward gear and chest loot in raid_ashwyrm_roost_items.json. Boss/trash loot tables live in raid_loot*.json.

props.text: The old Heronguard road. One arm points east: SKYREACH WATCH. Somebody has added, in fresh charcoal: 'and a dragon'.
A cairn of twenty-nine flat stones, one laid on another. Each has a name scratched on it. The top one says AUBRIC.
A Heronguard waymark, the heron chiselled off. Under it someone has scratched an eye in a flame.
Fallen blocks at the tower door. A scorched leather satchel is pinned under them.
Bones, broken spears and rags of river-blue cloth, half buried in ash.
A den under the drifts, its mouth staked with Dragonsworn chains. Something small and white whimpers inside.
A camp crate with Marta's stencil on it, dragged up here and chewed open.
A barrel from the camp, rolled all the way up the mountain. The lid is scorched through.
Another of Marta's crates, wedged in a crack and covered in tiny claw marks.
Where the cinder drakes fell, the ash is still warm.
Where Varkas fell: his maul, his drake-skull pauldron, and a great horn bound in gold.
The Ashwyrm's nest: charred branches, old bones, ash and straw, and three dark eggs.
A Dragonsworn altar of black stone, carved with a wyrm swallowing the sun. In the middle is a horn-rest, worn smooth.
Lord-Commander Aubric's heron standard, planted in the ash at the top of the world. It snaps in the wind like it's laughing.

regions.name: Ember Gate Camp
regions.text: Ember Gate Camp — the Brightwater expedition's tents, pitched where the pines give up. Somebody has labelled every crate.

regions.name: The Heron Road
regions.text: The Heron Road — the old knights' road to Skyreach Watch. The waymarks still stand. The herons on them do not.

regions.name: The Last Stand
regions.text: The Last Stand — under the broken tower, the ash lies over old bones and older spears. Twelve years, and nobody came to tidy up.
regions.successText: One of the cairns by the tower is wrong: too neat, too square, and the top stone has a heron scratched under the soot. A soldier's cache.
regions.failText: Ash, bones, broken spears. You keep your eyes on the ground and your thoughts to yourself.

regions.name: Frostclaw's Shelf
regions.text: Frostclaw's Shelf — the last snow on the mountain. Something huge has been pacing it in circles, for days.

regions.name: Cinder Terraces
regions.text: The Cinder Terraces — the stones are warm through your boots. Little scorched tracks go everywhere, like a nursery with a fire problem.

regions.name: Highlord's Court
regions.text: Skyreach Watch — the Heronguard's keep, now the Highlord's court. The Dragonsworn have hung their banners over every heron.

regions.name: Cloud-Sea Overlook
regions.text: The edge of the world: below you, the clouds lie like a white sea, and Skyreach's peaks stand up out of it like islands.

regions.name: Wyrm Stair
regions.text: The Wyrm Stair — steps cut by giant hands, each one taller than a dwarf. The air gets hotter as it goes up.

regions.name: The Summit
regions.text: The Summit — the crown of Skyreach, ringed in ash. The nest at its heart is the size of a cottage. High above, in the smoke, something enormous turns in slow circles.

quests.name: A Cold Welcome
quests.summary: The Dragonsworn chained Frostclaw's cubs in their den on the Shelf and burned ash-smoke at its mouth until the yeti matriarch went mad. She can't be saved. Her cubs can.

stages.description: Frostclaw paces the Shelf south of the Heron Road. Put the matriarch to rest.
Free the cubs from the Dragonsworn chains at the den on the east side of the Shelf.
Tell Marta at Ember Gate Camp.

quests.name: Twin Fires
quests.summary: The Cinder Drakes, Emberjaw and Ashtongue, sleep in the Drake Pit on the terraces. Put them down, and cut Marta a fire-gland: she can brew Emberward Draughts from it for the fight at the top.

stages.description: Defeat Emberjaw and Ashtongue in the Drake Pit on the Cinder Terraces. Stop Ashtongue mending her brother.
Cut a fire-gland from the fallen drakes.
Bring the fire-gland to Marta at Ember Gate Camp.

quests.name: The Highlord's Horn
quests.summary: Highlord Varkas holds Skyreach Watch with his Dragonsworn. He carries the Horn of Calling, the only thing that brings the Ashwyrm down out of her smoke.

stages.description: Defeat Highlord Varkas in his court at Skyreach Watch, south-east of the terraces.
Take the Horn of Calling from where Varkas fell.
Bring the horn to Marta at Ember Gate Camp.

quests.name: The Last Ember
quests.summary: Climb the Wyrm Stair, blow the Horn of Calling at the summit and bring Vyrmathra down. When the Ashwyrm dies, the Hollow dies with her.

stages.description: Climb the Wyrm Stair from the Watch's gate to the summit.
Blow the Horn of Calling at the Dragonsworn calling stone at the top of the stair.
Look into the Ashwyrm's nest at the back of the summit, and decide what becomes of her eggs.
Tell Marta at Ember Gate Camp that it is over.

quests.name: The Twenty-Nine
quests.summary: Twelve years ago forty Heronguard knights rode up Skyreach and twenty-nine stayed. Lord-Commander Aubric's standard is still up there, somewhere under the ash at the Last Stand.

stages.description: Climb to the Last Stand under the broken tower, up the slope north of the Heron Road.
Find Lord-Commander Aubric's standard among the fallen.
Bring the standard to Sir Hamon at his cairn by the camp.

quests.name: Small Fires
quests.summary: The ember whelps from the clutch on the Cinder Terraces have been raiding the camp's stores. Kesta would like them back, and the whelps discouraged.

stages.description: Drive off the ember whelps on the Cinder Terraces and recover the camp's three stolen stashes.
Bring the stores back to Kesta at the camp fire.
